_comment: PRD section 2's performance budgets. Rule R-E: budgets are laws — a gate is
never edited to make a build pass. ADR-018 §4: the absolute budget changes
only by ADR, with measured floor provenance.
THREE INSTRUMENTS, THREE NATURES (ADR-020 §1). The previous three budgets all
shared one defect: a single number bounded quantities of different natures and
inherited the worst behaviour of whichever term was noisiest.
steady   AnonPages + SUnreclaim + KernelStack + PageTables.
Process and kernel memory. Stable to ~9 MiB, so it can carry a
TIGHT gate that means something. Median of 3 full boots.
shmem    Shared memory — on Wayland, largely wl_shm graphics buffers. Not
stable and never will be, so it gets a CEILING rather than a
budget, sampled at its MINIMUM over a post-settle window so the
number describes the resting pool rather than a transient peak.
ratchet  Summed userspace PSS against a rolling baseline. The creep
detector and, on the evidence, the steadiest thing we measure.
MemTotal-MemAvailable and total committed are still recorded per run and gate
NOTHING. The first is kept because it is what `free` prints and therefore what
a user would quote back to us — the number in the conversation, not the gate.
ram.idle.ci is still product + offset, COMPUTED and never written down as a
literal, so the CI gate cannot move without editing the offset's provenance.

why: ADR-018 §1: median of 3 FULL boots, all values recorded — one run with
~50 MiB of noise once decided a gate with under 4 MiB of headroom.
ADR-020 §1b: after the settle, shmem is sampled across a 60 s window and
the MINIMUM taken, because a ceiling on a buffer pool should bound where
it rests, not where it happened to be when we looked.

steady.conditions: median of 3 runs, 2-minute settle each, 4 GB, GPU-rendered (ADR-020 §1a)
steady.canonical_seat: PRD 10.2 low-end row: 4 GB RAM, integrated GPU

floor_provenance.note: ADR-020 §2: these numbers are DERIVED from this set, so acceptance may not be declared on it. One fresh median-of-3 is required.

shmem.sampling: minimum over a 60 s window after the settle
shmem.status: provisional — pending ADR-020 §4 (the 117.8 outlier) and §3's renderer pair
shmem.why: A tripwire against a genuine buffer-pool regression, not a budget to tune against. Deliberately loose.

seed_provenance.method: ADR-020 §3 paired run, same build, median of 3 each

why: ADR-021. The ratchet is a CI instrument, so its baseline is measured in
CI's denomination. ADR-018 §3 seeded it at 576 — GPU-measured — and the
ratchet then fired at +179 on every healthy pull request, because
llvmpipe's software-render cost is anonymous memory that PSS counts.
That is the same one-renderer-baseline / other-renderer-measurement
error ADR-017 fixed for idle RAM, one instrument over.
NO OFFSET IS APPLIED HERE, and the asymmetry with `steady` is deliberate.
steady's canonical value is the GPU/product number, so its CI gate must
translate forever and stays a computed sum. The ratchet's canonical value
IS the CI history — it detects change over time where it runs — so it is
measured directly and the seed is only a bootstrap.
The seed RETIRES once 10 main-branch nightly runs exist; the baseline is
then their rolling median, measured in CI. The retirement mechanism is
part of the decision because a temporary constant with nothing arranged
to remove it is a permanent one.
The +25 threshold is unchanged and denomination-independent to first
order: a new resident service adds the same anonymous memory under both
renderers, so llvmpipe's overhead cancels in the delta.
gpu_reference_mib is informational and for the M-gate pairing check only
(ADR-021 §3). It never gates, and the two are NEVER cross-compared.

render_offset.method: ADR-020 §3 paired run, same build: llvmpipe steady median 948.1 (941.7/948.1/952.6) minus GPU steady median 759.9 (763.8/757.4/759.9)
render_offset.supersedes: 186.5 MiB and 182 MiB, both denominated in MemTotal-MemAvailable and retired with it
render_offset.note: Landing within 1.7 MiB of the old-metric 186.5 is a coincidence of two different denominations, not a confirmation. It is only evidence that llvmpipe's cost is mostly anonymous memory, which both statistics count.
render_offset.recalibrate: at every M-gate (ADR-017 §3); >25% drift is a finding, not an update

informational.idle_ram_mib: MemTotal - MemAvailable. Recorded per run, gates nothing (ADR-020 §1). What `free` shows.
informational.committed_mib: steady + Shmem. Recorded per run, gates nothing — ADR-019's trigger rejected it because Shmem's variance dominated it.

boot_seconds.conditions: cold boot, power-on to login screen, virtio SSD VM (PRD 2)
boot_seconds.note: Read from systemd's own firmware+loader+kernel+userspace total. Host-page-cache sensitive: the same image measured 16.9 s cold and 7.8 s warm, so a single over-gate reading on a busy host is not by itself a regression.
